title: Await BulkMarkScreen._expungeRefs's expunge writes before invalidating dependent providers
why: The loop fires expungePriorCompletions (which internally does multiple awaited DB writes) without awaiting it, then immediately calls ref.invalidate on the dashboard/progress providers. Because those providers are manually invalidated rather than backed by a reactive .watch() stream, the invalidated providers can refetch before the un-awaited expunge write lands, showing the user a stale (pre-expunge) completion count right after unticking a previously-marked item. Confirming this needs a widget test with a deliberately delayed fake CompletionRepository asserting the provider's value immediately after _toggleItem completes.
recommendation: await Future.wait(refs.map((r) => service.expungePriorCompletions(...))) before the ref.invalidate calls, or move invalidation into a .whenComplete() continuation.
acceptance_criteria: a test with an artificially delayed expunge write asserts the dashboard provider reflects the post-expunge count immediately after the awaited toggle completes, not the pre-expunge count
